headline: Turkey State Fund TMSF Takes Over Management of 21 Companies in Probe
summary: Turkey's Savings Deposit Insurance Fund was appointed by prosecutor order to manage 21 companies following an investigation into investment fund transactions in Istanbul.
why: TMSF is Turkey's state asset authority responsible for managing distressed financial institutions and seized commercial assets.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Public trusteeship intervention places commercial assets under state control.
